title: Recovering the Difference Where a Reduced Promotional Deposit Was Taken
content:
Where a package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products was opened on a reduced promotional deposit, the difference to the product's standard deposit is not written off, and part or all of it falls due with the call. The product's standard deposit for the party is its deposit per traveller multiplied by the travellers the package records as travelling; its reduced promotional deposit for the party is its reduced promotional deposit per traveller multiplied by the same number.

**Where the product allows a reduced promotional deposit and the deposit lines on the package come to no more than the product's reduced promotional deposit for every traveller travelling**, the whole difference between the product's standard deposit for the party and the deposit lines actually taken falls due with this call.

**Where the product allows a reduced promotional deposit and the deposit lines on the package come to more than the product's reduced promotional deposit for the party but less than the product's standard deposit for the party**, one half of that difference — 50 per cent of it — falls due with this call, and the rest falls due with the final instalment.

**In every other case** — the product allows no reduced promotional deposit, or the deposit lines already come to the product's standard deposit for the party or more — nothing falls due with this call as a deposit difference.

## The deposit lines against the two figures

| What the deposit lines on the package come to | Falls due with this call |
| --- | --- |
| no more than the product's reduced promotional deposit for the party | the whole difference to the standard deposit for the party |
| more than that, but less than the standard deposit for the party | one half of that difference |
| the standard deposit for the party or more, or the product allows no reduced deposit | nothing |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package recording 2 travellers on a product whose deposit is 200.00 USD per traveller and whose reduced promotional deposit is 79.00 USD per traveller: the standard deposit for the party is 400.00 USD and the reduced promotional deposit for the party is 158.00 USD.

Deposit lines of 158.00 USD come to no more than the reduced promotional deposit for the party, so the whole difference of 242.00 USD falls due with this call. Deposit lines of 250.00 USD come to more than 158.00 USD and less than 400.00 USD, so one half of the difference of 150.00 USD, being 75.00 USD, falls due with this call and 75.00 USD falls due with the final instalment. Deposit lines of 400.00 USD leave nothing to fall due as a deposit difference.
